**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Textarea/title children must be scalar text expressions; elements and fragments are not supported
```

## How to fix

Give `<textarea>/<title>` only text or a string expression: `` <title>{`${name} – Site`}</title> ``; move markup out.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <textarea><b /></textarea>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <textarea>{"text"}</textarea>;
```
